body:
ATR-2026-00298, -00299 and -01830 to -01856 detect requests for help with fraud, trafficking, extremist content, doxxing and similar harm. They carried ASI08 Cascading Failures and LLM02 Sensitive Information Disclosure, which describe neither the attack nor its effect. Each keeps ASI01 and LLM01, which it already had.

ATR-2026-00209 (runaway tool invocation through a retry directive) maps to LLM10 Unbounded Consumption instead of LLM09 Misinformation. Its provenance said human-reviewed.

Only references.owasp_agentic and references.owasp_llm changed in 25 files; every other field is identical when parsed, and every rule still has an agentic and an LLM mapping.

Checked locally: validate:compliance, audit:mappings --require-full, both crosswalk --check, check-rules-safety against the PR3 head, gate:generalization.

Left for the maintainer: ATR-2026-00281 (EICAR/GTUBE test-string request) and ATR-2026-00289 (harmful-content elicitation) map only to ASI08 and LLM02. They read as content-safety rules rather than agent threats.
title: fix(rules): drop OWASP ASI08 and LLM02 from 24 harmful-request rules
head: fix/mapping-owasp
